Correct the theta-family sentence about singleton criticality. Under the deletion-only convention every singleton deletion has negative surplus for K>=3; the missing hypothesis is positive surplus of the original graph. At m=10,K=6 the original surplus is -74 and deleted surpluses are -90 or -72.
